name: Cube SDF Sampling and Sign Configuration
definition: Constructs a cube by sampling the SDF at its 8 vertices. Vertices with SDF value exactly 0 are perturbed by adding $10^{-6}$ to ensure a strict sign.
summary: Cube SDF Sampling and Sign Configuration determines a voxel's topological state by sampling eight vertices and perturbing zero values to prevent ambiguity.
